name: base-app-capacitor
description: Optional Capacitor shell for Phaser-only games: the shared Phaser game in the system WebView, without React Native.

scripts.android:apk: npm run build && npm run native && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run build && npm run native && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.android:run: npm run build && npm run native && cap run android
scripts.ios:open: npm run build && npm run native && cap open ios
